recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work should use a specific tracker if a live build-scope dependency from core to a non-core profile or IG is found; FHIR-5928 itself is too broad to justify speculative source edits now.
issue_request: FHIR-5928 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking to refactor the specification/build system so core was self-contained and no longer had to point at non-core profiles or change core resource spreadsheets whenever external profiles were added.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5928 was found. The apparent application was through untagged 2015 source/build refactors that removed old fhir.ini IG/profile coupling, disabled HSPC dictionary coupling, moved DAF/SDC-style content toward separate guide inputs, and started new IG infrastructure; the Jira closure comment said the broader work remained ongoing but core had been done.
additional_context: Nearby ballot comments FHIR-7780, FHIR-7791, and FHIR-7793 raised the same profile/build modularity concern but were resolved as no-change/not ballotable or out of scope. Later FHIR-12384 removed US Core extensions from core, and current source/fhir.ini keeps the us-core profile entry commented out.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source configuration already reflects the concrete core decoupling relevant to the Jira examples, while remaining profile entries are FHIR-defined/core extension/profile inputs rather than the old external-profile build coupling.

related_jiras.note: Repeated the request that profiles point to base resources rather than base resource spreadsheets declaring all profiles; resolved No Change as not ballotable though partly done/in progress.
